patches.title: Surface Check Before Open
patches.principle: Move to each container to check its top before opening it.
patches.when_to_apply: When searching for an object and closed containers are present.

patches.title: Switch Type After Two Empties
patches.principle: After opening two containers of the same type and finding nothing, switch to a different container type.
patches.when_to_apply: When two consecutive same-type containers are empty.

patches.title: Exhaust Open Surfaces First
patches.principle: Search all open surfaces like countertops and cabinet tops before opening any closed container.
patches.when_to_apply: When you enter a room and need to locate an object.
